name: PancakeBunny BUNNY minter spot LP valuation
summary: PriceCalculatorBSC.valueOfAsset() priced WBNB-paired Cake-LP from the pair's spot WBNB balance, and BunnyMinterV2.mintForV2() minted BUNNY in proportion to that value with no cap. Flash-loaned WBNB pumped into the BUNNY-WBNB pair made a tiny VaultFlipToFlip getReward() mint 8M BUNNY, which the attacker sold into both BUNNY/WBNB pairs.
notes: Loss is the WBNB the two BUNNY/WBNB pairs gave up for the minted BUNNY. The flash-swap fees the attacker paid out of it are not subtracted (rule 11); the 697k BUNNY it kept is not valued.

No other mint above 5,000 BUNNY from the minter between its creation and block 7800000 is an exploit (admin mints of 10,000 and large CAKE harvests), so the anchor is the first and only exploit on BSC.
